sources.title: Fichier des localités du 5e RGPH (2019)
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
sources.reuse_note: Official 2019 locality population by sex and age, including source-noted estimates for security-affected places. Use the 2019 13-region/45-province/351-commune geography; do not relabel it as the 2025 17-region/47-province system. Recheck raw redistribution terms.

sources.title: Guide méthodologique de planification locale: PCD (December 2024)
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances
sources.reuse_note: December 2024 communal development-plan (PCD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Check the guide's current applicability and the chosen locality's legal planning authority; no local plan is implied.

sources.title: Guide méthodologique de planification locale: PRD (December 2024)
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances
sources.reuse_note: December 2024 regional development-plan (PRD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Do not equate a 2019 statistical region with a current planning body without legal crosswalk.

sources.title: Loi n°024-2025/ALT portant Code général des collectivités territoriales
sources.publisher: Assemblée législative de transition / Académie de Police du Burkina Faso
sources.reuse_note: Law no. 024-2025/ALT cover and parliamentary adoption were checked. The 114-page posted PDF is scanned; its article-level requirements and present applicability were not text-verified. Verify exact articles and current consolidated status before prescribing a planning index.

sources.title: Rapport national 2024 sur les plans locaux de développement
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances, DGDT
sources.reuse_note: National 2024 monitoring report on local development plans, published in 2025. It is a planning-system reference, not evidence that any selected commune's plan or budget was obtained or approved. Check any area-specific document separately.

sources.title: Disparités communales de la pratique contraceptive au Burkina Faso
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2015 outcome model, 2019 census covariates; August 2023 report
sources.reuse_note: This is a modelled 2015 outcome using 2019 census covariates, not 2019 contraceptive prevalence. Three ambiguous commune name matches were withheld; review the crosswalk and raw reuse terms.

sources.title: RGPH 2019 Volume 3: Mesure et cartographie de la pauvreté
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2018 household survey with 2019 census frame; Annexes 5-9 use RGPH 2019
sources.reuse_note: Volume 3 Annex 4 monetary-poverty values are small-area estimates combining EHCVM 2018 with 2019 census geography, not directly enumerated census poverty. Annexes 5-9 report distinct census measures. Two whole-city commune aggregates and four incomplete rows were withheld; recheck definitions, geography, and redistribution terms.

sources.title: Résultats du 5e RGPH: volume des tableaux statistiques
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
sources.reuse_note: Official statistical-table volume has 581 identified table headings. AreaData adopted columns from only eight tables, including age-sex Table I.20. Inspect the remaining tables and every numeric column before claiming full adoption; regional rates are not commune rates.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022: Preliminary Report
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Bangladesh project, not newly discovered by AreaData. Recheck the current BBS page and exact report before acquisition; AreaData independent audit and redistribution-terms review are pending.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022: District Community Series (64 workbooks)
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Bangladesh project, not newly discovered by AreaData. Verify each district workbook and local geography independently; AreaData audit and source-terms review are pending.

sources.title: Results of Population and Housing Census 2015
sources.publisher: Lao Statistics Bureau / UNFPA Lao PDR
sources.license_or_terms: Source-site public access terms; redistribution status reviewed per retained file
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Lao project, not newly discovered by AreaData. This is the detailed 2015 census, not published 2025 local census results. Recheck report and geography; AreaData independent audit is pending.

sources.title: Lao PDR Subnational Population Statistics 2024
sources.publisher: UNFPA / Lao Statistics Bureau, distributed by HDX
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Lao project, not newly discovered by AreaData. UNFPA/LSB 2024 population statistics distributed via HDX are not 2024 census counts; recheck definitions, geography and redistribution terms.

sources.title: UBOS NPHC 2024 subcounty profiles — Uganda-LGDP normalized extraction
sources.reuse_note: AreaData adapted Uganda-LGDP normalized UBOS 2024 census data. The original UBOS workbook was not present in the adapter source checkout; reacquire and verify official originals and scope, including APAA, before use. Independent AreaData audit is pending.

sources.title: Local Government Development Planning Guidelines, second edition
sources.reuse_note: AreaData inherited this NPA guidance location through Uganda-LGDP resources. Verify the exact edition, applicability and PDF before use; AreaData independent audit and redistribution-terms review are pending.

sources.title: NPA local government plan catalogue
sources.reuse_note: NPA local-government plan catalogue location only. Area-specific plans, dates, duplicates and content must be checked individually; no plan is assumed current or adopted in Kit.
